title: feat(ploeg): post a usage and evidence report on every agent pull request
body:
Implements the OpenSpec change `report-run-usage-on-pull-requests` (merged as https://forgejo.webgrip.dev/webgrip/glide/pulls/12).

**Correct base branch: `development`.** The tooling may open this against `main`; a human must retarget it to `development`.

## What and why

A reviewer of an agent pull request could not see what the agents actually did or cost without leaving the PR: Ploeg posted only each reader's findings and, on budget exhaustion, a notice. This change publishes one usage and evidence report per agent PR, kept current in place.

- **One comment, edited in place.** `pkg/shiftengine/usage.go` is a pure renderer; `Engine.publishUsageReport` finds the comment by the `<!-- ploeg:usage-report -->` marker and edits it, or creates it when absent. The forge SPI gains `Comment`, `Comments` (pagination to exhaustion) and `EditComment`; Forgejo and GitLab implement them.
- **Per Run and in total.** `store.ShiftUsage` reads a Shift's ledger and finished Runs in one query: Role, Round, wrote, Outcome, verdict, models, prompt/completion tokens, cost, duration and account state. The Shift totals show authorized, spent, reserved and remaining pool, the Rounds used and the close reason, and the writing Run's trace alias `ploeg-<12hex>`.
- **Provisional and unavailable are explicit.** An unreconciled account marks its cost and tokens `provisional`; a Run with no readable spend shows `unavailable`, never the authorization dressed as cost. A reconciled Shift heads `_Settled._`.
- **Evidence, not a copy.** The writing Run's verification result and commit are parsed from its stored summary marker and findings section; when none was recorded the report says so and names no commit.
- **Links from configuration.** `PLOEG_REPORT_GRAFANA_URL` and `PLOEG_REPORT_VLOER_URL` drive the Glide — Loop dashboard, the Run Explorer per Run, Spend & Attribution per Team and Vloer's Ploeg overview. Unset omits those links; both unset omits the section and the report still renders.
- **Best-effort, never in the lifecycle.** A failed read, list or write is logged and skipped; a failed list never posts blind (no duplicate). The settlement sweep refreshes the comment after a successful `Settle` (new `ShiftEngine.RefreshUsageReport`, `UnsettledLLMAccount.ShiftID`). No Outcome, close reason or Work Item state changes.

## Files

- SPI + providers: `pkg/provider/provider.go`, `pkg/provider/forgejo/forgejo.go`, `pkg/provider/gitlab/gitlab.go`
- Store: `pkg/store/usage.go`, `pkg/store/llm_settlement.go`, `pkg/store/shift.go`
- Renderer + publishing: `pkg/shiftengine/usage.go`, `pkg/shiftengine/publish.go`, `pkg/shiftengine/engine.go`
- Wiring: `pkg/httpapi/server.go`, `cmd/ploegd/main.go`, `cmd/ploegd/sweep.go`
- Chart: `ops/helm/ploeg/values.yaml` (generic `env` map; no `values.schema.json` change) and the eight goldens
- Docs: `docs/how-to/review-an-agent-pr.md`, `apps/ploeg/docs/reference/configuration*`

## Evidence

`openspec validate report-run-usage-on-pull-requests --type change --strict` and `openspec validate --all --strict` both pass locally (exit 0):

```
Change 'report-run-usage-on-pull-requests' is valid
Totals: 17 passed, 0 failed (17 items)
```

`$PLOEG_VERIFY_SCRIPT` (gofmt) passes:

```
+ if [ -f apps/ploeg/go.mod ]; then test -z "$(gofmt -l apps/ploeg)"; fi
ploeg-verify: all 1 checks passed
```

Regression tests added (run by CI; see below for why they cannot run here): SPI conformance and per-provider pagination/edit tests, `pkg/store` `ShiftUsage` and `ShiftID` tests, the pure renderer's golden/provisional/unavailable/alias/evidence/links tests, the engine's create-once-edit-in-place/list-failure/edit-failure/close/no-lifecycle-change tests, and `cmd/ploegd` sweep-refresh and env tests.

## Checks left to CI

The sandbox has no Go module cache and no registry egress (the module downloads time out), so `go build`, `go vet ./...`, `go test ./...` and the Helm golden render could not run here. Example of the failure:

```
pkg/store/store.go:20:2: github.com/jackc/pgx/v5@v5.10.0: Get "https://proxy.golang.org/...": dial tcp 216.58.198.17:443: i/o timeout
```

Left to CI: `gofmt -l .`, `go vet ./...`, `go build ./...`, `go test ./...`, and `scripts/helm-golden.sh check` (helm is not installed here; the goldens were updated by hand, so CI is the authority on the render).

## Risk notes from self-review

- **Failure paths.** Every failure returns early after logging; the list-before-write ordering means a failed list can never post a duplicate. The refresh after settlement is best-effort and cannot fail the settlement that already succeeded.
- **Money paths.** The report only reads: no mint, no settle, no block, no gateway call. It prints the alias and never a key value or `gateway_key_id`.
- **Concurrency.** No new race: the report is a single list-then-edit on the single ploegd publisher. No blocking call was added to the renewal path; the sweep's per-account refresh is the existing sequential loop.
- **Harness column (please re-check).** The brief asks each Run to show its **harness**, but `agent_runs` has no harness column and this change's protected areas forbid a migration. I did **not** invent a harness value. The Run's Role, Outcome and models (including `deepseek/deepseek-flash`) are shown. This is recorded in the design's Open Questions and is the one acceptance sub-item not fully met; it needs either a new column (a migration the ticket forbids) or the worker writing a harness field into the usage JSON.
